description: This file implements REST storage handlers for Kubernetes namespace resources, including main namespace storage, status subresource, and finalizer subresource, with logic for namespace deletion and lifecycle management.

classes.name: REST
classes.description: Main storage handler for namespaces, including create, update, delete, list, watch, and namespace lifecycle management.

classes.name: StatusREST
classes.description: Subresource handler for namespace status updates.

classes.name: FinalizeREST
classes.description: Subresource handler for namespace finalizer updates.

methods.name: NewREST
methods.description: Factory function to create namespace storage handlers for main, status, and finalizer subresources.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles namespace deletion, including setting deletion timestamp, phase, and finalizers.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the namespace object or its subresources.

methods.name: ConvertToTable
methods.description: Converts namespace objects to tabular format for display.
